visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright indoor studio. A woman with long hair sits at a grand piano on the right, her hands ready on the keys. In the center, a man wearing a white 'Anonymous' mask stands behind a professional microphone. Two young boys wearing oversized white fur coats are positioned in the foreground; one holds green fruits while the other holds a small gold-colored gong. (2) The group starts a musical performance. Visual effects including digital flames at the bottom and stylized clouds at the top are overlaid. The boys sing with wide-mouthed expressions and gestures, while a CGI black snake is edited to wrap around their necks and shoulders. The man in the mask sings with a steady posture, and a digital flame occasionally appears on his head. (3) The scene cuts to an outdoor location featuring a traditional stone wall and green trees. A woman in a red martial arts vest and black pants performs high kicks, punches, and poses with intense facial expressions. She is also seen breaking a rectangular stone prop over a man lying on a park bench. (4) The final phase returns to the studio where the entire group raises their arms and cheers at the camera. The video ends with a montage of the woman in red continuing her martial arts routine in front of a red-roofed traditional building with festive graphic borders.

The arousal level is high, with rapid vocal delivery of festive slogans.
